# Janus OS

> Image-deployed NixOS router. The definition suite is English. The manual is English, then Russian, then Persian.

## Start here

- [Assistant guide](ai.md): how to answer questions about this project
- [English manual](en/README.md): the user-facing guide
- [Russian manual](ru/README.md)
- [Persian manual](fa/README.md)

## Do not invent

- Router commands are specified in [docs/14-cli.md](../docs/14-cli.md)
- Build-host commands are specified in [docs/16-build-host-cli.md](../docs/16-build-host-cli.md)
- What the code actually contains is [docs/13-roadmap.md](../docs/13-roadmap.md)
